a: Veha para – detammoye metammenan leh, ditnan: metammein hayu hakkohen hassoref et happara umatbilin oto, lehotzi millibban shel tzaddukin shehayu omrim: bimorve shemesh hayta naaset; shema minna: la pasla bah (machshevet) tumea!
Shane para, hoil ditvul yom la pasel bah. i hachi, lema li dimkaddesh? keen avoda [baenan].
Ibbaya lehu: mahu lekaddesh yadav [veraglav] bakkiyyor? "mimmennu" amar rachamana – velo betocho; o dilma afillu betocho?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, ta shema: o shettaval beme meara veavad – avodato pesula. ha me chiyyor dumeya deme meara, veavad – avodato keshera!
La, me meara itztericha leh; shello tomar: kol gufo tovel bahen – yadav veraglav lo kol shekken?!
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar yosef: me chiyyor nifsalin lemattirin kemattirin, leevarim keevarim.
Rav chisda amar: af lemattirin en nifsalin ella beammud hashshachar, kaevarin. verabbi yochanan amar: kiyyor kevan sheshshikkeo – shuv en maalehu.
Lememra delaavodat layla name la chaze?! vehaamar rabbi assi, amar rabbi yochanan mishshemeh deilfa: kiyyor shello shikkeo mibbaerev – mekaddesh mimmennu laavodat layla, ulemachar eno mekaddesh!
May "eno maalehu" name dekaamar – laavodat yom; aval laavodat layla chaze.
[I hachi] hayeynu derabbi chiyyay bar yosef!
b: Ikka benayyhu gezerat shikkua.
Vehaamar rabbi yochanan: kiddesh yadav litrumat haddeshen – lemachar en tzarich lekaddesh, shekkevar kiddesh mittechillat avoda.
Bishlama lerava, demokem lehahi kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon – ha kerabbi.
Ella leabbaye demokem la kerabbi – kashya derabbi adderabbi: may shena hatam dimshakka leh, umay shena hacha dela meshakka leh?
Dimsallek leh vahadar meshakka leh.
I hachi, "lemachar eno mekaddesh" – [ammay? en tzarich lekaddesh.]
Lememra dilmattirin michza chaze?! hayeynu derav chisda!
Ikka benayyhu mitzvat shikkua.

Metivi: lo hayu roin oto velo shomin et kolo, ad sheshshomim kol shel etz sheasa ben katin mucheni lakkiyyor, vehen omrim: higgia [et] kiddush yadayim veraglayim min hakkiyyor. may, lav dimsallek leh? alma meshakka leh!
La, dimshakka leh. i dimshakka leh – mi mishtema kaleh?! meshakka leh begilgela.
Lishshana acharina: dimshakka leh bechumarteh, ki hechi delishtema kaleh velishmei velete. veha hava gevini karoz! (bi) [abbe] tere hekkere havo avdi; deshama mehay ate, veshama mehay ate.
Gufa – amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: kol kiyyor sheen bo kede lekaddesh arbaa kohanim mimmennu – en mekaddeshin bo, shenneemar: "verachatzu mimmennu moshe veaharon uvanav vegomer".
Metivi: kol hakkelim mekaddeshin – ben sheyyesh bahen reviit,

a: Ben sheen bahen reviit; uvilvad sheyyehu kele sharet!
Amar rav adda bar acha: bekodeach betocho.
Veha "mimmennu" amar rachamana! "yirchatzu" – lerabbot keli sharet.
I hachi, keli chol name! amar abbaye: keli chol la matzet amrat, mikkal vachomer mikkanno; uma kanno, shennimshach immo – eno mekaddesh; keli chol, sheeno nimshach immo – eno din sheeno mekaddesh?!

Vechanno menalan? detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: yachol yehe kanno mekaddesh kederech shehakkiyyor mekaddesh? talmud lomar: "veasita kiyyor nechoshet vechanno nechoshet" – linchoshet hikkashtiv velo ledavar acher.
Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: ma lechanno – sheen asuy letocho; tomar bichli chol – sheasuy letocho?! ella "mimmennu" – lemaote keli chol.
I hachi, keli sharet name! ha rabbi rachamana "yirchatzu".
Uma raita? ze taun meshicha kamohu, veze en taun meshicha kamohu.
Amar resh lakish: kol hammashlim leme mikve – mashlim leme chiyyor. lirviit – eno mashlim.
Lemaote may? illema lemaote tit haniddok – hechi dame? i defara shocha veshota mimmennu, afillu lirviit name! vei en para shocha veshota mimmennu, afillu lemikve name en mashlim!

Ella lemaote yavchushin adummin – afillu beenayyhu name! deha tanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol shettechillat beriyyayto min hammayim – matbilin bo; veamar rav yitzchak bar avdimi: matbilin beeno shel dag!

Amar rav pappa: lemaote natan sea venatal sea. ditnan: mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mechvvavnot; natan sea venatal sea – hare ze kasher. veamar rav yehuda bar shela amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: ad rubbo.
Amar rav pappa: im kadach bo reviit – matbilin bo mechatin vetzinnoriyyot, hoil umehechshera demikve ate.
Amar rabbi yirmeya amar resh lakish: me mikve kesherim leme chiyyor.

Lememra dela mayim chayyim ninhu?! vehatanya: "bemayim" – velo beyayin, "bemayim" – velo bemazug, "bemayim" – lerabbot shear mayim; vekal vachomer leme chiyyor. may kal vachomer leme chiyyor? lav demayim chayyim ninhu?
La, (likdosh) dekaddish vekaddishe mealleyuta hi. veha tana deve shemuel: "mayim" – sheen lahem shem levavy,
b: Yatzu me chiyyor sheyyesh lahem shem levavy. ella lav diruyin leme chiyyor? alma mayim chayyim ninhu!
Tannae hi. deamar rabbi yochanan: me chiyyor – rabbi yishmael omer: me mayan hen, vachachamim omrim: shear memot hen.
Arel menalan? amar rav chisda: davar ze mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu, middivre yechezkel ben buzi lamadnu: "kol ben nechar erel lev veerel basar lo yavo el mikdashi lesharteni".
Umenalan demachali avoda? dichtiv: "bahaviachem et bene nechar arle lev vearle vasar lihyot bemikdashi lechallel et beti".

Tanu rabbanan: "ben nechar" – yachol ben nechar mammash? talmud lomar "erel lev". im ken, ma talmud lomar "ben nechar"? shennitnakkeru maasav leaviv shebbeshamayim. veen li ella erel lev; erel basar minnayin? talmud lomar: "veerel basar".

Utzerichi; dei ketav rachamana: "erel basar" – mishshum dimis; aval erel lev, dela meis – ema la. vei ashmeinan erel lev – mishshum deen libbo lashshamayim; aval erel basar, delibbo lashshamayim – ema la; tzerichi.
Tame pasul. amru zikne darom: lo shanu ella teme sheretz; aval teme met – mittoch shemmeratztze betzibbur, meratztze name beyachid.
I hachi, teme sheretz name – lete bekal vachomer mitteme met: ma teme met, shettaun hazzaa shelishi ushevii – meratztze; teme sheretz, sheeno taun hazzaa shelishi ushevii – eno din shemmeratztze?!
Kasavri zikne darom: mechapperin – kemitkapperin; ma mitkapperin – teme met in, teme sheretz la; af mechapperin – teme met in, teme sheretz la.
May kasavri? i kasavri: en shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz; ammay la avdi tzibbur betumea? ha kol shebbeyachid nidche – tzibbur avdi betumea!
Ella kasavri: shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz.
Amar ulla, teka lehu resh lakish lidromae: vechi eze koach merubbe – koach mechapperin o choach mitkapperin? heve omer: koach mitkapperin;

Uma bimkom shennitmeu bealim besheretz meshallechin korbenotehen – kohen shennitma besheretz eno meratztze; mekom shennitmeu bealim bemet, sheen meshallechin korbenotehen – kohen shennitma bemet eno din sheeno meratztze?!
Kasavri zikne darom: teme met [name] meshalleach korbenotav.
Vehachtiv: "ish ish ki yihye tame vaase pesach bechodesh hashsheni vegomer"! lemitzva.
Veha ketiv: "ish

a: Lefi ochlo"! lemitzva.

Uleakkove la?! vehatanya: "bemichsat nefashot" – melammed sheen happesach nishchat ella limnuyav. shechato shello limnuyav – yachol yehe keover al hammitzva? talmud lomar: "tachossu" – hakkatuv shana alav leakkev. veittakkash ochlin limnuyin!

Zikne darom la makkeshi. vechi la makkeshi name – meha name it lehu pircha: uma bimkom shennitmeu bealim besheretz, shemmeshallechin korbenotehem lechattechilla – kohen shennitma besheretz eno meratztze; mekom shennitmeu bealim bemet, sheen meshallechin korbenotehen lechattechilla – kohen shennitma bemet eno din sheeno meratztze?!
Metivi, mippene sheamru: nazir veose fesach – hatztzitz meratztze al tumeat dam, veen hatztzitz meratztze al tumeat hagguf.
Bemay? illema betumeat sheretz, haamrat: shochatin vezorkin al tumeat sheretz! ella tumeat met; vekatane: en hatztzitz meratztze; alma nitmeu bealim bemet – en meshallechin korbenotehem!
La; i deittammo bealim bemet – hachi name; hacha bemay askinan – kegon shennitma kohen besheretz.
I hachi, ema sefa: nitma tumeat hattehom – hatztzitz meratztze. ha tane rabbi chiyyay: lo amru tumeat hattehom – ella lemet bilvad; lemet lemaote may? lav lemaote tumeat hattehom desheretz?!
La; lemaote tumeat hattehom deziva.
Veella ha devae rame bar chama: kohen hameratztze bekorbenotehem – huttera lo tumeat hattehom, o lo huttera lo tumeat hattehom? tifshot detumeat hattehom huttera lo; deha hacha bechohen kayaymina!
Derame bar chama vadday peligi.
Ta shema: "venasa aharon et avon hakkodashim" – vechi ezehu avon nose?
b: Im avon piggul – hare kevar neemar "lo yechashev"! im avon notar – hare kevar neemar "lo yeratze"!
Ha eno nose ella avon tumea, shehuttera mikkelalah betzibbur.
May tumea? illema mittumeat sheretz, hecha ishteray? ella tumeat met. velav kegon shennitmeu bealim bemet? alma nitmeu bealim bemet – meshallechin korbenotehen.
Uvemay? i benazir – "vechi yamut met alav" amar rachamana! ella leose fesach! (velav kegon shennitmeu bealim bemet?)
Leolam besheretz; veshem tumea baolam.
Veikka dedayek umayyte hachi: avon hakkodashim in, avon makdishin la; may tumea? ilema tumeat sheretz – mi ishteray betzibbur?! ella lav tumeat met? vaavon kodashim in, avon makdishim la!
Leolam tumeat sheretz; veshem tumea baolam.
Yoshev menalan? amar rava amar rav nachman, amar kera: "laamod lesharet" – laamida bechartiv, velo lishiva.
Tanu rabbanan: "laamod lesharet" – mitzva; keshehu omer: "haomdim" – shana alav hakkatuv leakkev.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman: mikkedi yoshev kezar dame umachel avoda, ema: ma zar bemita – af yoshev bemita! allema tanya: aval arel, onen, yoshev – enan bemita ella beazhara?
Mishshum dehave mechussar begadim veshello rachutz yadayim veraglayim – shene chetuvin habbain keechad,

a: Vechol shene chetuvim habbain keechad – en melammedin.
Uleman deamar melammedin – shetuye yayin have leh shelishi, ushelosha ledivre hakkol en melammedin.

Omed al gabbe kelim, al gabbe behema, al gabbe ragle chavero – pasul. menalan? detana deve rabbi yishmael: hoil veritzpa mekaddeshet uchele sharet mekaddeshim; ma kele sharet – lo yehe davar chotzetz beno leven kele sharet, af ritzpa – lo yehe davar chotzetz beno leven haritzpa.
Utzericha; dei ashmeinan keli – mishshum delav mina devasar ninhu; aval behema, demina devasar hu – ema la. vei ashmeinan behema – dela mina deadam hu; aval chavero, deadam hu – ema la; tzericha.

Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: raglo achat al hakkeli veraglo achat al haritzpa, raglo achat al haeven veraglo achat al haritzpa – roin; kol sheillu yinnatel hakkeli vetinnatel haeven, yachol laamod al raglo achat veyaavod – avodato keshera; veim lav – avodato pesula.

Bae rabbi amme: niddaldela haeven veamad aleha, mahu? hecha deen dato lechabberah – la tibbee lach, devadday chayytza. ki tibbee lach – dedato lechabberah. may? kevan dedato lechabberah – kema dimchabbera damya; o dilma, hasheta miha ha telisha?
Rabba zute bae la hachi, bae rabbi amme: neekra haeven veamad bimkomah, mahu?
May ka mibbaya leh? ki kaddesh david – ritzpa elyona kaddesh; o dilma ad learit tehoma kaddesh, vetibbee leh kol haazara kullah?
Leolam peshita leh dead arit tehoma kaddesh; vehachi kamibbaya leh: derech sherut bechach, o en derech sherut bechach? teku.
Kibbel bismol – pasul, verabbi shimon machshir. tanu rabbanan: "beetzbao" "velakach" – melammed shello tehe kabbala ella beyamin. "beetzbao venatan" – melammed shello tehe netina ella beyamin.
Amar rabbi shimon: vechi neemra yad bekabbala?! ella "beetzbao venatan" – shello tehe netina ella beyamin; hoil velo neemra yad bekabbala – kibbel bismol kasher.
Verabbi shimon – mimma nafshach; i it leh gezera shava – ki lo neemra yad bekabbala may have? vei let leh gezera shava – ki neemra yad bekabbala may have?
Amar rav yehuda: leolam let leh gezera shava; vehachi kaamar: vechi neemar yad yamin bekabbala?! hoil velo neemar yad yamin bekabbala, kibbel bismol – kasher.
Amar leh rabba: i hachi, afillu netina name! veod, vechi let leh lerabbi shimon gezera shava?! vehatanya, rabbi shimon omer: kol makom shenneemar yad – enah ella yamin, etzba – enah ella yamin!
Ella amar rava: leolam it leh gezera shava; vehachi kaamar: vechi neemra yad bekabbala?! hoil velo neemra yad bekabbala ella etzba, vei efshar lekabbel beetzba; kibbel bismol – kasher.
Amar leh rav samma bereh derav ashe leravina: ifshar deaved leh ozen lisfat mizrak, umekabbel ba!
Ella amar abbaye:
b: Bemikra nidrash lefanav uleacharav kamippalgi.

Amar abbaye: ha derabbi elazar berabbi shimon – mappeka middaavu, umappeka midderabbanan. detanya, rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: kol makom shenneemar etzba bekabbala – shinna bakkabbala, pasul; bannetina, kasher. vechol makom shenneemar etzba bintina – shinna bannetina, pasul; bakkabbala, kasher.
Vehechan neemar etzba bintina? dichtiv: "velakachta middam happar venatatta al karnot hammizbeach beetzbaecha", vekasavar: mikra nidrash lefanav, velo lifne fanav uleacharav.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom shenneemar etzba uchehunna – enah ella yamin.

Ka salka datin tarte baenan – kedichtiv: "velakach hakkohen middam hachattat beetzbao", veyalef mimmetzora – dichtiv: "vetaval hakkohen et etzbao hayemanit". vahare kemitza – dela ketiv ba ella kehunna; utenan: kamatz bismol – pasul!
Ella amar rava: o etzba, o kehunna.

Amar leh abbaye: hare holachat evarim lakkevesh – dichtiv behu kehunna, dichtiv: "vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol [vehiktir] hammizbecha"; veamar mar: zo holachat evarim lakkevesh; utenan: haregel shel yamin bismolo, uvet orah lachutz!
[Ki amrinan] o etzba o kehunna – bedavar hameakkev kappara, dumeya dimtzora.
Vahare kabbala – dichtav behu kehunna, vedavar hameakkev bechappara hu; utenan: kibbel bismol – pasul, verabbi shimon machshir!
Rabbi shimon tarte bae.
Mi bae rabbi shimon tarte?! vehatanya, rabbi shimon omer: kol makom shenneemar yad – eno ella yamin, etzba – eno ella yamin!
Etzba – la baaya kehunna, kehunna – baaya etzba.
Veella kohen lema li? (bechihunnan) [bechihunno].
Vahare zerika – dela ketiv behu ella kehunna; utenan: zarak bismol – pasul, vela pelig rabbi shimon!
Amar abbaye: pelig bevarayyta – detanya: kibbel bismol – pasul, verabbi shimon machshir. zarak bismol – pasul, verabbi shimon machshir.
Ella ha deamar rava: "yad"–"yad" likmitza, "regel"–"regel" lachalitza, "ozen"–"ozen" lirtzia; lema li? midderabba bar bar chana nafka!
Chad lekometz, vechad lekiddush kometz.

a: Ulerabbi shimon – dela bae kiddush kometz; uleman deamar lerabbi shimon name bae kiddush – kometz bismol achshore machshar; "yad"–"yad" derava lema li?
I likmitza atzmah – midderav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay nafka; deamar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: may tama derabbi shimon? deamar kera: "kodesh kadashim hi kachattat vechaasham";
Ba leovdah bayyad – ovdah beyamin, kechattat; ba leovdah bichli – ovdah bismol, keasham!
Lo nitzrecha [ella] lekometz minchat chote; salka datach amena, hoil veamar rabbi shimon shello yehe korbano mehuddar – ki kamatz la bismol name tittachshar; ka mashma lan.
Mishna nishpach haddam al haritzpa, vaasafo – pasul.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "velakach hakkohen hammashiach middam happar" – middam hannefesh, velo middam haor velo middam hattamtzit.

"Middam happar" – dam mehappar yekabbelennu. dei salka datach "middam happar" kedichtiv – "middam" vaafillu miktzat dam; vehaamar rav: hashshochet tzarich sheyyekabbel et kol damo shel par, shenneemar: "veet kol damo yishpoch"!
Ella "middam happar" – dam mehappar yekabbelennu. vekasavar: gorin umosifin vedorshin.
Gufa – amar rav yehuda amar rav: hashshochet tzarich sheyyekabbel et kol damo shel par, shenneemar: "veet kol dam happar yishpoch". veha beshirayim ketiv!
Im eno inyan leshirayim – deha leteh lechulleh dam; tenehu inyan (bekabbala) [lekabbala].
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hashshochet tzarich sheyyagbiah sakkin lemala, shenneemar: "velakach middam happar" – velo middam happar vedavar acher.
Vedam sakkin bemay mekannach leh? amar abbaye: bisfat mizrak, kedichtiv: "kefore zahav".
Amar rav chisda amar rav yirmeya bar abba: hashshochet tzarich sheyyitten
b: Veridin letoch hakkeli. ittemar name, amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: veridin tzarich sheyyiru avir keli.
Bea minneh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan: haya mekabbel, venifchatu shule mizrak ad shello higgia dam laavir – mahu? avir sheen sofo lanuach – kemunnach dame, o la kemunnach dame?
Amar leh, tenetuha: chavit shemmunnachat tachat hazzinnuk – mayim shebbetochah veshebbechutza la, pesulin. tzeraf piha lazzinnuk – mayim shebbetochah pesulin, veshebbechutza lah kesherin.
Hay may bae minneh – avir sheen sofo lanuach; veka fashet leh avir shessofo lanuach!
Tarte ka vae minneh; im timtze lomar: avir sheen sofo lanuach – lav kemunnach dame, avir shessofo lanuach may?
Rav yosef matne hachi. rav kahana matne: chavit bea minneh, ufeshat leh chavit.
Rabba matne: chavit bea minneh, ufeshat leh mizrak – i atta mode bemizrak, shei ifshar lo belo zinnuk?!

Tenan hatam: natan yado o raglo o ale yerakot kede sheyyaavru mayim lechavit – pesulin. ale kanim vaale egozim – keshera. ze hakkelal: davar hamekabbel tumea – pesulin, davar sheeno mekabbel tumea – kesherin.
Mena hane mille? deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose bar abba, amar kera: "ach mayan uvor mikve mayim yihye tahor" – havayaytan al yede tohora tehe.
Amar rabbi chiyyay amar rabbi yochanan: zot omeret, avir keli kichli dame.
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi chiyyay bar abba: vedilma beshotet? amar leh: terada! "kede sheyyaavru mayim lechavit" tenan!

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: meeduto shel rabbi tzadok nishnet mishna zo; ditnan: heid rabbi tzadok al hazzochalin shekkillechan baale egozin – shehen kesherin; ze haya maase beohaliyyay, uva maase lifne chachamim belishkat haggazit, vehichshiru.
Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi: hatztzorem ozen happar, veachar kach kibbel damo – pasul; shenneemar: "velakach middam happar" – par shehaya kevar.
Ashkechan kodshe kodashim; kadashim kallim menalan?

Amar rava, tanya: "se tamim zachar ben shana" – sheyyehe tamim uven shana bishat shechita. bekabbala, beholacha, bizrika – minnayin? talmud lomar: "yihye" – kol havayyotav lo yihyu ella tam uven shana.
Etiveh abbaye, rabbi yehoshua omer: kol hazzevachim shebbattora shennishtayyer mehen kezayit basar o kezayit chelev – zorek et haddam!
Targuma abben shana.
Umi ikka midde devishat shechita ben shana, bishat holacha uzerika ben shetem?!
Amar rava: zot omeret, shaot poslot bakkodashim.
Amar rabbi amme amar rabbi elazar: hi bifnim veragleha bachutz; chatach veachar kach shachat – keshera,

a: Shachat veachar kach chatach – pesula.
Chatach veachar kach shachat – keshera?! baal mum ka makriv! ella ema: chatach veachar kach kibbel – keshera, kibbel veachar kach chatach – pesula.
Chatach veachar kach kibbel – keshera?! veha amar rabbi zera: hatztzorem ozen bivchor, veachar kach kibbel damo – pasul; shenneemar: "velakach middam happar" – par shehaya kevar!
Amar rav chisda amar avimi: chotech baevar ad shemmaggia laetzem.
Kibbel veachar kach chatach – pesula. shamat minna: dam hammuvela baevarim – dam hu?
Dilma mishshum shamnunit.
Shamat minna: besar kadashim kallim sheyyatza lifne zerikat dam – pasul?
Dilma bekodshe kadashim.

Tanu rabbanan: kodshe kadashim – shechitatan batztzafon, vekibbul daman bichli sharet batztzafon. amad baddarom, vehoshit yado latztzafon veshachat – shechitato keshera. kibbel – kabbalato pesula. hichnis rosho verubbo – keillu nichnas kullo. pirkesa veyatzta laddarom vechazra – keshera.

Kadashim kallim – shechitatan bifnim, vekibbul daman bichli sharet bifnim. amad bachutz, vehichnis yado lifnim veshachat – shechitato keshera. kibbel – kabbalato pesula; vehichnis rosho verubbo – keillu lo nichnas. pirkesa veyatzta lachutz vechazra – pesula. shema minna: besar kadashim kallim sheyyatza lifne zerikat damim – pesulim!
Dilma bealya veyoteret hakkaved ushete chelayot.
Bea minneh avu dishmuel mishshemuel: hi bifnim veragleha bachutz, mahu?
Amar leh: ketiv "vehevium laAdonai" – ad shettehe kullah lifnim.
Tala veshachat, mahu? amar leh: keshera. amar leh: ishtabbasht; baenan shechita al yarech, velekka.
Nitla veshachat, mahu? amar leh: pesula. amar leh: ishtabbasht; shechita al yarech, velo shochet al yarech.
Nitla vekibbel, mahu? amar leh: keshera. amar leh: ishtabbasht; en derech sherut bechach.
Tala vekibbel, mahu? amar leh: pesula. amar leh: ishtabbasht; shechita al yarech, velo kabbala al yarech.
Amar abbaye: bekodshe kadashim – kullan pesulot, bar minnitla veshachat. bekadashim kallim – kullan kesherot, bar min nitla vekibbel.
Amar rava: may shena tala vekibbel bekadashim kallim – dichshera, daavir penim kifnim dame? bekodshe kadashim name – avir tzafon ketzafon dame!
Ella amar rava: ben bekodshe kadashim ben bekadashim kallim – kesherot; bar min tala veshachat – bekodshe kadashim, nitla vekibbel – ben bekodshe kadashim ben bekadashim kallim.

Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: hu bifnim vetzitzito bachutz, mahu? amar leh: lav amrat "vehevium laAdonai" – ad shettavo kullah lifnim? hacha name, "bevoam el ohel moed" – ad sheyyavo kullo leohel moed.

Mishna netano al gabbe hakkevesh; shello keneged hayesod; natan et hannittanin lematta lemala; veet hannittanin lemala lematta; veet hannittanin bifnim bachutz; veet hannittanin bachutz bifnim – pasul, veen bo karet.
b: Gemara amar shemuel: pasul basar, aval bealim nitkapperu. may tama? deamar kera: "vaani netattiv lachem al hammizbeach lechapper" – kevan shehiggia dam lammizbeach, nitkapperu bealim.
I hachi, basar name! amar kera: "lechapper" – lechappara netattiv, velo ledavar acher.

Alma kasavar: shello bimkomo – kimkomo dame. tenan beiddach pirkin: netano al hakkevesh shello keneged hayesod; natan et hannittanin lematta lemala; veet hannittanin lemala lematta; veet hannittanin bifnim bachutz; veet hannittanin bachutz bifnim – im yesh dam hannefesh, yachzor hakkasher vikabbel.
Vei salka datach shello bimkomo kimkomo, lema li yachzor hakkasher vikabbel? vechi tema lehattir basar baachila – mi ikka zerika dela mechappera, vesharya basar baachila?!
I deyahaveh kasher – hachi name; hacha bemay askinan – deyahaveh pasul.
Velihve dachuy! ditnan: vechullan shekkibbelu chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo – im yesh dam hannefesh, yachzor hakkasher vikabbel. kibbelu in, zarku la; may tama? lav mishshum dehave dachuy?
La; mishshum difsil bemachshava.
I hachi, kabbala name! veod, mi pasla machshava?! vehaamar rava: en machshava moelet ella bemi sherauy laavoda, uvedavar harauy laavoda, uvemakom harauy laavoda!
La tema: zarku la, ella ema: shachatu la.
May ka mashma lan – defasla machshava? tenena: lefichach hen poslin bemachshava!
Ha ka mashma lan – demikkabbala veelach la pasla machshava. may tama? kidrava.
Metivi: chishshev litten et hannittanin lemala lematta; lematta lemala – lealtar kasher (lemachar pasul). chazar vechishshev

a: Chutz limkomo – pasul, veen bo karet. chutz lizmanno – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet.
Lemachar – pasul. chazar vechishshev ben chutz lizmanno ben chutz limkomo – pasul, veen bo karet.
Vei shello bimkomo kimkomo dame, hay pasul?! piggul hu!
Amar mar zutera: zerika desharya basar baachila – mayytya lide piggul, zerika dela sharya basar baachila – la mayytya lide piggul.

Amar leh rav ashe lemar zutera: mena lach ha? dichtiv: "veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav... piggul yihye" – mi sheppiggulo garam lo; yatza ze – sheen piggulo garam lo, ella issur davar acher garam lo.
I hachi, ippesole name la lippesel!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: midde dehave ammachshevet hinnuach veallibba derabbi yehuda.
Resh lakish amar: leolam pasul mammash, veshello bimkomo kimkomo dame. vela kashya; kan shennatan bishtika, kan shennatan baamira.
Tenan: chishshev litten et hannittanin lematta lemala; lemala lematta ad midde dehave ammachshevet hinnuach veallibba derabbi yehuda kulei.
Rabbi yochanan amar: idde veidde shennatan bishtika, veshello bimkomo lav kimkomo dame. veha deikka dam hannefesh, ha delekka dam hannefesh.
Tenan: pasul veen bo karet. bishlama leresh lakish, hayeynu dekatane pasul veen bo karet.
Ella lerabbi yochanan, may en bo karet? kashya.
Velishmuel, may en bo karet? hachi kaamar: im natan bemachshava – pasul veen bo karet.
Verabbi yochanan – i shello bimkomo lav kimkomo dame; leheve ki nishpach min hakkeli al haritzpa – veyaasfennu!

Savar la keman daamar lo yaasfennu. deamar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim bannittanin lemala shennetanan lemala, lematta shennetanan lematta; shello kemitzvatan – lo yaasfennu. lo nechleku ella bannittanin lemala shennetanan lematta, lematta shennetanan lemala – sherabbi yose omer: lo yaasfennu, verabbi shimon omer: yaasfennu.
b: Umishnatenu kedivre haomer lo yaasfennu.

Verav chisda amar avimi: hakkol modin bannittanin lematta shennetanan lemala – shello yaasfennu; vechol shekken bannittanin lemala shennetanan lematta – hoil vedamim haelyonim lematta hen bain. lo nechleku ella bannittanin lifnim shennetanan bachutz, bachutz shennetanan lifnim – sherabbi yose omer: yaasfennu, verabbi shimon omer: lo yaasfennu.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: af anan name tenena, rabbi yehuda omer: "zot hi haola" – hare ellu miutin; perat lenishchata ballayla veshennishpach damah vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim – im alta tered.

Rabbi shimon omer: "ola" – en li ella ola keshera; minnayin lerabbot shennishchata ballayla, veshennishpach damah, vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim, vehallan, vehayyotze, vehattame, veshennishchat chutz lizmanno, vechutz limkomo, veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damah, vehannittanin lemala shennetanan lematta, vehannittanin lematta shennetanan lemala, vehannittanin bifnim shennetanan bachutz, vehannittanin bachutz shennetanan bifnim, vehappesach vehachattat sheshshechatan shello lishman – minnayin?
Talmud lomar: "torat haola" – ribba tora achat lechol haolin, sheim alu lo yerdu.
Yachol sheani merabbe af harovea, vehannirba, vehammuketze, vehanneevad, vehaetnan, vehammechir, vehakkilayim, vehatterefa, veyotze dofen? talmud lomar: "zot".
Uma raita lerabbot et ellu ulehotzi et ellu? merabbe ani et ellu – shehaya pesulan bakkodesh, umotzi ani et ellu – shello haya pesulan bakkodesh.
Katane miha: hannittanin lematta shennetanan lemala, ulemala shennetanan lematta – vela pelig rabbi yehuda; may tama? lav mishshum dekalteh mizbeach – ushema minna: lo yaasfennu.
Amar rabbi eliezer: mizbeach happenimi mekaddesh pesulin.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: hannittanin befanim kulei!
I mehatam, hava amena: hane mille dam – dachaze leh; aval kometz, dela chaze leh – ema la; ka mashma lan.
Metivi: ketoret zara (sheala) [shealta] legabbe mizbeach – tered; sheen lecha mekaddesh pesulin ella mizbeach hachitzon berauy lo. chitzon in, penimi la!

Taretz hachi: ketoret zara shealta lemizbeach hachitzon – tered; sheen mizbeach hachitzon mekaddesh pesulin ella harauy lo, vehappenimi ben rauy lo ben sheen rauy lo. may tama? hay ritzpa, vehay kele sharet.

Mishna hashshochet et hazzevach lizrok damo bachutz o miktzat damo bachutz, lehaketir emurav bachutz o miktzat emurav bachutz, leechol besaro bachutz o kezayit mibbesaro bachutz, o leechol kezayit meor haalya bachutz – pasul, veen bo karet.

Lizrok damo lemachar, miktzat damo lemachar, lehaketir emurav lemachar o miktzat emurav lemachar, leechol besaro lemachar o kezayit mibbesaro lemachar, o leechol kezayit meor haalya lemachar – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet.
Gemara savruha: or alya –

a: Kealya dame; veha ka mechashshev meachilat mizbeach leadam!
Amar shemuel: ha manni – rabbi eliezer hi; deamar: mechashshevin meachilat mizbeach laachilat adam, umeachilat adam laachilat mizbeach.
Ditnan: hashshochet et hazzevach leechol davar sheen darko leechol; lehaketir davar sheen darko lehaketir – kasher. verabbi eliezer posel.
Bemay okemta – kerabbi eliezer? ema sefa, ze hakkelal: kol hashshochet, vehamekabbel, vehammolich, vehazzorek; leechol davar sheddarko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheddarko lehaketir.
Davar sheddarko leechol in, sheen darko leechol la; atan lerabbanan. resha rabbi eliezer vesefa rabbanan?! amar leh: in.
Rav huna amar: or alya – lav kealya dame. amar rava: may tama derav huna? "chelbo haalya" – velo or haalya.
Rav chisda amar: leolam or haalya kealya dame; vehacha bemay askinan – bealya shel gedi.
Kullehu kishmuel la amri – resha rabbi eliezer vesefa rabbanan la mokmi. kerav huna la amri – or alya kealya dame ka mashma lehu.
Kerav chisda – may tama la amri? may ka mashma lan – or alya kealya deme?! tenena: veellu sheorotehen kivsaran – or shettachat haalya!

Verav chisda – itzterich; salka datach amena: hane mille leinyan tumea – derakkich mitzteref. aval hacha, ema "lemoshcha" – ligdulla, kederech shehammelachim ochlin; vela avidi melachim deachli hachi, ema la; ka mashma lan.
Metivi: hashshochet et haola lehaketir kezayit meor shettachat haalya; chutz limkomo – pasul, veen bo karet; chutz lizmanno – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet.

Elazar ben yehuda ish avelim omer mishshum rabbi yaakov, vechen haya rabbi shimon ben yehuda ish kefar ikkus omer mishshum rabbi shimon: echad or bet happerasot behema dakka, veechad or harosh shel egel harach, veechad or shettachat haalya, vechol shemmanu chachamim gabbe tumea "veellu sheorotehen kivsaran" – lehavi or shel bet habboshet; chutz limkomo – pasul, veen bo karet; chutz lizmanno – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet.
Ola in, aval zevach la; bishlama lerav huna – hayeynu dekatane "ola"; ella lerav chisda – may irya detane "ola"? litne "zevach"!
Amar lecha rav chisda: ibbaet ema, bealya shel gedi; veibbaet ema, teni: "zevach".
Pasul veen bo karet kulei. mena hane mille? amar shemuel: tere kerae ketivi.
May hi? amar rabba: "shelishi" – zehu chutz lizmanno.
"Piggul" – zehu chutz limkomo. "vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu" – echad velo shenayim; zehu chutz lizmanno, ulemaote chutz limkomo.
Veema: "vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu" – zehu chutz limkomo, ulemaote chutz lizmanno! mistabbera chutz lizmanno adif – diftach beh. adderabba! chutz limkomo adif – dismich leh!

Ella amar abbaye: ki ata rav yitzchak bar avdimi [amar rav], samech addetane tanna: keshehu omer "shelishi" befarashat "kedoshim tihyu" – sheen talmud lomar, shehare kevar neemar: "veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach hashshelamim beyom hashshelishi";
b: Im eno inyan lechutz lizmanno, tenehu leinyan chutz limkomo; umiet rachamana gabbe notar: "veochlav avono yissa" – lemaote chutz limkomo.
Veema: "veochlav avono yissa" – zehu chutz limkomo, ulemaote notar mikkaret!
Mistabbera notar hava leh leokome becharet – lemigmar "avon"–"avon" lechutz lizmanno, dedame leh bezv.
Adderabba! chutz limkomo hava leh leokome becharet – lemigmar "avon"–"avon" lechutz lizmanno, dedame leh bemkdsh!

Ella amar rabbi yochanan, tane zavdi bar levi: atya "kodesh"–"kodesh"; ketiv hacha: "et kodesh Adonai chillel venichreta", uchetiv hatam: "vesarafta et hannotar baesh vegomer"; ma lehallan notar, af kan notar.
Umiet rachamana gabbe notar "veochlav avono yissa" – lemaote chutz limkomo mikkaret.
Umay chazet dikra aricha – bechutz lizmanno, ushelishi" defarashat "kedoshim tihyu" – chutz limkomo? efoch ana!
Mistabbera aricha bechutz lizmanno – degamar "avon"–"avon" minnotar, dedame leh bezv.
Adderabba! aricha bechutz limkomo, ushelishi" dikdoshim tihyu" bechutz lizmanno – mishshum dedame leh, samcheh veka memaet leh!
Ella amar rava: kullehu mikkera aricha atayin; dichtiv: "heachol yeachel" – bishte achilot hakkatuv medabber, echad achilat adam veechad achilat mizbeach.
"Mibbesar zevach shelamav" – ma shelamim mefaggelin umitpaggelin, af kol mefaggelin umitpaggelin.
"Shelishi" – ze chutz lizmanno.
"Lo yeratze" – keharetzaat kasher, ken haretzaat pasul; uma haretzaat kasher – ad sheyyakrivu kol mattirav, af haretzaat pasul – ad sheyyakrivu kol mattirav.
"Hammakriv" – behakerava hu nifsal, veeno nifsal bishlishi. "oto" – bazzevach hakkatuv medabber, veeno medabber bakkohen.
"Lo yechashev" –

a: Lo yearev bo machshavot acherot.
"Piggul" – ze chutz limkomo.
"Yihye" – melammed shemmitztarfin ze im ze.
"Vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu" – echad velo shenayim; veeze? ze chutz lizmanno – degamar "avon"–"avon" minnotar, dedame leh bezv.
Amar leh rav pappa lerava: ledidach, "shelishi" defarashat "kedoshim tihyu" – may darshat beh? hahu mibbee leh lemakom sheyyehe meshullash bedam, bevasar uveemurin.
Tippok li mikra kamma: "im heachol yeachel" – middeappekeh rachamana bilshon "shelishi"!
Amar rav ashe: amrita lishmata kammeh derav matna; amar li: i mehatam, hava amena: "shelishi" – perat, "piggul" – kelal; venaase kelal musaf al happerat, veitrabbo shear mekomot; ka mashma lan.

Tanu rabbanan: "veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav" – amar rabbi eliezer: kof oznecha lishmoa – bimchashshev leechol mizzivcho bayyom hashshelishi hakkatuv medabber. o eno ella beochel mizzivcho leyom shelishi? amarta: achar shehu kasher, yachzor veyippasel?!
Amar lo rabbi akiva: hen! matzinu bezav vezava veshomeret yom keneged yom – shehen bechezkat tohora, vechevan sherau satru; af atta al titma al ze – sheaf al pi shehucheshar, sheyyachzor veyippasel.

Amar leh: hare hu omer "hammakriv" – bishat hakerava hu nifsal, veeno nifsal bashshelishi. o eno omer "hammakriv" ella ze kohen hammakriv? keshehu omer "oto" – bazzevach hu medabber, veeno medabber bakkohen.
Ben azzay omer: "oto" ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar: "lo teacher leshallemo" – yachol af meacher nidro belo yeratze? talmud lomar: "oto" – oto belo yeratze, veen hameacher nidro belo yeratze.
Acherim omrim: "lo yechashev" – bemachshava hu nifsal, veeno nifsal bashshelishi.
Uven azzay – divzevach hakkatuv medabber veeno bechohen, mena leh? i baet ema: nafka leh middaacherim, veibbaet ema: middichtiv "lo yeratzu" velo yeratze" – zivcha hu.
Uven azzay – oto belo yeratze" veen meacher nidro belo yeratze", mehacha nafka?! middaacherim nafka! detanya, acherim omrim: yachol yehe bechor sheibbera shenato –
b: Kifsule hammukedashin, veyippasel?
Talmud lomar: "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha masar degancha vegomer" – makkish bechor lemaaser; ma maaser – eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah, af bechor – eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah.
Itzterich; salka datach amena: hane mille bechor, delav bar haretzaa hu; aval kadashim, divne haretzaa ninhu – ema la liratztzo; ka mashma lan.
Veakkatti mehatam nafka?! "vehaya vecha chet" – velo bekorbancha chet!

Uven azzay – hahu mibbee leh: "vehaya vecha chet" – velo beishtecha chet. salka datach amena: hoil veamar rabbi elazar veittema rabbi yochanan: en ishto shel adam meta ella im ken mevakkeshin mimmennu mamon veen lo, shenneemar: "im en lecha leshallem lamma yikkach mishkavcha mittachtecha" – behay avon deval teacher" name meta; ka mashma lan.
Acherim omrim: bemachshava hu nifsal, veeno nifsal bishlishi. verabbi eliezer – "lo yechashev" may aved leh?
Mibbee leh lechidrabbi yannay – deamar rabbi yannay: minnayin lemachshavot shemmotziot zo mizzo? shenneemar: "lo yechashev" – lo yearev bo machshavot acherot.
Verav mari matne, amar rabbi yannay: minnayin limchashshev bekadashim shehu loke? talmud lomar: "lo yechashev".
Amar leh rav ashe lerav mari: lav sheen bo maase hu, vechol lav sheen bo maase – en lokin alav! amar leh: rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: lav sheen bo maase – lokin alav.

Mishna ze hakkelal: kol hashshochet, vehamekabbel, vehamehallech, vehazzorek; leechol davar sheddarko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheddarko lehaketir; kezayit; chutz limkomo – pasul, veen bo karet. chutz lizmanno – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet; uvilvad sheyyakriv hammattir kemitzvato.

Ketzad karav hammattir kemitzvato? shachat bishtika, kibbel vehillech vezarak chutz lizmanno; o sheshshachat chutz lizmanno, vekibbel vehillech vezarak bishtika; o sheshshachat vekibbel vehillech vezarak chutz lizmanno – zehu shemmakriv hammattir kemitzvato.

Ketzad lo karav hammattir kemitzvato? shachat chutz limkomo, kibbel vehillech vezarak chutz lizmanno; o sheshshachat chutz lizmanno, kibbel vehillech vezarak chutz limkomo; o sheshshachat vekibbel vehillech vezarak chutz limkomo (velizmanno).

Happesach vehachattat sheshshechatan shello lishman, vekibbel vehillech vezarak chutz lizmanno; o sheshshachat chutz lizmanno, kibbel vehillech vezarak shello lishman; o sheshshachat vekibbel vehillech vezarak daman shello lishman – zehu shello karav hammattir kemitzvato.
Leechol kezayit bachutz kezayit lemachar; kezayit lemachar kezayit bachutz; kachatzi zayit bachutz kachatzi zayit lemachar; kachatzi zayit lemachar kachatzi zayit bachutz – pasul, veen bo karet.

Amar rabbi yehuda, ze hakkelal: kol shemmachshevet hazzeman kadma lemachshevet hammakom – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet. veim machshevet hammakom kadma lemachshevet hazzeman – pasul, veen bo karet. vachachamim omrim: ze vaze – pasul, veen bo karet. leechol kachatzi zayit lehaketir kachatzi zayit – kasher; sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin.
Gemara amar ilfa: machloket bishte avodot; aval baavoda achat – divre hakkol eruv machshavot have. verabbi yochanan amar: af baavoda achat machloket.
Bishlama leilfa – midderesha bishte avodot, sefa name bishte avodot. ella lerabbi yochanan – resha bishte avodot, vesefa baavoda achat?!

a: In; resha – bishte avodot, sefa – ben baavoda achat ben bishte avodot.

Tenan: amar rabbi yehuda, ze hakkelal: im machshevet hazzeman kadma lemachshevet hammakom – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet. bishlama lerabbi yochanan – hayeynu dekatane "ze hakkelal". ella leilfa – may "ze hakkelal"? kashya.
Tenan hatam: "hare zo temurat ola temurat shelamim" – hare zo temurat ola. divre rabbi meir.

Amar rabbi yose: im lechach nitkavvevn techilla, hoil vei efshar lehotzi shete shemot keachat – devarav kayyaymin; veim mishsheamar "hare zo temurat ola", venimlach veamar "hare zo temurat shelamim" – hare zo ola.
Ibbaya lehu: "hare zo temurat ola ushelamim", mahu? "lachatzot", mahu?
Amar abbaye: beha vadday mode rabbi meir. rava amar: adayin hi machloket.
Amar rava leabbaye: ledidach deamrat beha vadday mode rabbi meir; hare shechita – (dilchi) [dichi] "lachatzot" dame, ufeligi!
Amar leh: mi savrat enah lishchita ella levassof?! yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof; umishnatenu – deamar: siman rishon chutz lizmanno, siman sheni chutz limkomo.
Hare kemitza – (dilchi) [dichi] lachatzot dame, ufeligi!
Hatam name – shehiktir kometz mincha chutz lizmanno, kometz levona chutz limkomo.
Hare kometz deminchat chote – delekka levona bahadeh, ufeligi!
La peligi. amar rav ashe: im timtze lomar peligi, peligi bifsiot.
Rav shimi bar ashe matne kidabbaye, rav huna bar natan matne kidrava.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar: rabbi meir – beshitat rabbi yehuda amarah, deamar: tefos lashon rishon.
Ditnan: amar rabbi yehuda, ze hakkelal: im machshevet hazzeman kadma et machshevet hammakom – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet.
b: Amar leh abbaye, veha rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: ki maggeat lehu rabbi meir verabbi yose bahade hadade, la peligi!
Vela peligi?! veha miflag peligi! amar leh: peligi bemay difligi, vela peligi bemay dela peligi.

Deamar rabbi yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim hecha deamar "tachul zo veachar kach (amar) tachul zo" – divre hakkol la chayyla; "lo tachul zo ella im ken chala zo" – divre hakkol chayyla;
Ki peligi, deamar: "temurat ola temurat shelamim". rabbi meir savar: middahava leh lememar "temurat ola ushelamim" vaamar "temurat ola temurat shelamim" – shema minna mihdar ka hadar beh.
Verabbi yose – i amar: "temurat ola ushelamim" – hava amena palga temurat ola ufalga temurat shelamim; lehachi amar: "temurat ola temurat shelamim" – lememra dechulla ola vechulla shelamim havya.
Amar leh: hu amar la peligi, vaana amena peligi.
Amar ulla veittema rav oshaya: efshar yadin chavrin bavlaa – "kezayit" "kezayit" tenan, o "kezayit" "uchezayit" tenan?
"Kezayit" "kezayit" tenan – aval "kezayit" "uchezayit" divre hakkol eruv machshavot have; o dilma "kezayit" "uchezayit" tenan, dilrabbi yehuda perata have – vechol shekken "kezayit" "kezayit"?
Ta shema, diva minneh levi merabbi: chishshev leechol kezayit lemachar bachutz, mahu? amar lo: zo sheela! eruv machshavot have.

Amar lefanav rabbi shimon berabbi: lo mishnatenu hi?! leechol kezayit bachutz kezayit lemachar; kezayit lemachar kezayit bachutz; kachatzi zayit bachutz kachatzi zayit lemachar; kachatzi zayit lemachar kachatzi zayit bachutz – pasul, veen bo karet. ha iddach – eruv machshavot have!
Amar leh: hu shaal bi devar chachma, veat amarta mishnatenu?! ledidach deatnitach tarte – la kashya lach;

Ledideh dela atniteh ella chada, veshaminhu lerabbanan deka garsi tarte – vesavar: didi davvka, vedidhu eruv machshavot have? o dilma didhu davvka, uledidi shayyore shayyayr li; umiddeshayyayr li ledidi ha – shayyayr lehu ledidhu name behach?
Vehe atneyeh? illema "kezayit" "uchezayit" atneyeh – hay lav shiyyura hu! ella "kezayit" "kezayit" atneyeh.
Vetibbee leh "kezayit" "uchezayit"!

Sevar: ive minneh chada – deshamana tarte. dei baena "kezayit" "uchezayit" – ha nicha i amar li kelala, kol shekken "kezayit lemachar bachutz"; ella i amar li perata – akkatti "kezayit lemachar bachutz" ka mibbaya li.
I hachi, hasheta name – hatinach i amar leh "kezayit lemachar bachutz" perata, kol shekken "kezayit" "uchezayit"; ella i amar leh kelala, akkatti "kezayit" "uchezayit" mibbee leh!
Im ken mirtach ratach:

a: Hasheta "kezayit" "uchezayit" kelala, "kezayit lemachar bachutz" mibbaya?!
Lishshana acharina: "kezayit lemachar bachutz" perata, "kezayit" "kezayit" mibbaya?!
Ittemar: chatzi zayit chutz lizmanno, chatzi zayit chutz limkomo, vachatzi zayit chutz lizmanno – amar rava: "vayyikatz keyashen" happiggul. verav hamenuna amar: eruv machshavot have.
Amar rava: mena amena la? ditnan: kevetza ochel rishon uchevetza ochel sheni shebbelalan ze baze – rishon. chillekan – ze sheni veze sheni. ha chazar veervan – rishon have.
Mimmay? middekatane sefa: nafel ze beatzmo veze beatzmo al kikkar shel teruma – pesaluha. naflu shenehen keachat – asauha sheniyya.
Verav hamenuna amar: hatam ikka shiura, hacha lekka shiura.
Amar rav hamenuna: mena amena la? ditnan: haochel shennitma beav hattumea, veshennitma bivlad hattumea – mitztarfin ze im ze letamme bakkal shebbishnehem. may, lav af al gav dahadar malleyeh?
Dilma dela hadar malleyeh!
Ki ata rav dimi amar: chatzi zayit chutz limkomo, vachatzi zayit chutz lizmanno, vachatzi zayit chutz lizmanno – tane bar kappara: piggul; en chatzi zayit moil bimkom kezayit.
Ki ata ravin amar: chatzi zayit chutz lizmanno, vachatzi zayit chutz lizmanno, vachatzi zayit chutz limkomo – tane bar kappara: piggul; en chatzi zayit moil bimkom kezayit.
Rav ashe matne hachi: chatzi zayit chutz lizmanno, uchezayit – chetzyo chutz limkomo vechetzyo chutz lizmanno; tane bar kappara: piggul; en chatzi zayit moil bimkom kezayit.
Amar rabbi yannay: chishshev sheyyochluhu kelavim lemachar – piggul; dichtiv: "veet izevel yochlu hakkelavim bechelek yizreel".

Matkef la rabbi amme: ella meatta, chishshev shettochlehu esh lemachar, dichtiv: "teochlehu esh lo nuppach" – hachi name defiggul?! vechi tema hachi name; vehatnan: leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir chatzi kezayit – kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin!
I deappeka bilshon achila – hachi name; hacha bemay askinan – deappeka bilshon haketara. dilshon achila lechod, uleshon haketara lechud.
Bae rav ashe: chishshev leechol kezayit bishne bene adam, mahu? batar machshava azlinan – deikka shiura, o vatar ochlin azlinan – velekka shiura?
Amar abbaye, ta shema: leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit – kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin.
b: Ha leechol veleechol dumeya deleechol ulehaktir, vehechi dame – bishne bene adam; mitztaref! shema minna.
Bae rava: chishshev leechol kezayit beyater mikkede achilat peras, mahu? laachilat gavoah medammenan leh, o laachilat hedyot medammenan leh?

Amar abbaye, ta shema: leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit – kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin. tama deleechol ulehaktir, ha leechol veleechol – mitztaref; veha haketara beyoter mikkede achilat peras hu!
Dilma behessek gadol.
Leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit – kasher. tama deleechol ulehaktir, ha leechol veleechol davar sheen darko leechol – mitztaref;
Ha katane resha: leechol et sheddarko leechol – mitztaref; et sheddarko leechol in, sheen darko la!

Amar rabbi yirmeya: ha manni – rabbi eliezer hi, deamar: mechashshevin meachilat adam laachilat mizbeach, umeachilat mizbeach laachilat adam. ditnan: hashshochet et hazzevach leechol davar sheen darko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheen darko lehaketir – kasher. verabbi eliezer posel.
Abbaye amar: afillu tema rabbanan – vela tema: ha leechol veleechol davar sheen darko leechol, ella ema: ha leechol veleechol davar sheddarko leechol.
May ka mashma lan? i davar sheddarko leechol ka mashma lan – meresha shema minna: kachatzi zayit bachutz kachatzi zayit lemachar – pasul; ha kachatzi zayit lemachar – piggul!
Ella i leechol ulehaktir – middukeya deresha shema minna: leechol davar sheddarko leechol – in, sheen darko leechol – lo;
Hasheta uma leechol veleechol davar sheen darko leechol – la mitztaref, leechol ulehaktir mibbee?!
Leechol ulehaktir itzterich; salka datach amena: hatam hu delav ki orcheh ka mechashshev; aval hacha, divhay ki orcheh uvehay ki orcheh – ema litztaref; ka mashma lan.
Hadaran alach kol hazzevachim shekkibbelu daman

Mishna kol happesulin sheshshachatu – shechitatan keshera, shehashshechita keshera bezarim uvenashim uvaavadim uvitmeim. vaafillu bekodshe kadashim, uvilvad shello yihyu temeim nogin babbasar. lefichach hen poslin bemachshava.

a: Vechullan shekkibbelu et haddam chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo – im yesh dam hannefesh, yachzor hakkasher vikabbel.

Kibbel hakkasher venatan lappasul – yachzir lakkasher. kibbel bimino venatan lismolo – yachzir limino. kibbel bichli kodesh venatan lichli chol – yachzir lichle kodesh. nishpach min hakkeli al haritzpa vaasafo – kasher.

Netano al gabbe hakkevesh; shello keneged hayesod; natan et hannittanin lematta – lemalan; veet hannittanin lemalan – lematta; veet hannittanin bifnim – bachutz; veet hannittanin bachutz – bifnim; im yesh dam hannefesh – yachzor hakkasher vikabbel.
Gemara "shachatu" – diavad in, lechattechilla la.
Ureminhu: "veshachat" – shechita bezar keshera, shehashshechita keshera bezarim uvenashim uvaavadim uvitmeim. vaafillu bekodshe kadashim. o eno ella bakkohanim?
Amarta: vechi meayin bata – mikkelal shenneemar: "veatta uvanecha ittecha tishmeru et kehunnatchem lechol devar hammizbeach";
Yachol af bishchita? talmud lomar: "veshachat et ben habbakar lifne Adonai vehikrivu vegomer" – mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna; limmed al hashshechita shekkeshera bechol adam.
Hu haddin daafillu lechattechilla name; umishshum deka bae lemitna temeim – dilchattechilla la, gezera shemma yiggeu babbasar; tena: "sheshshachatu".
Vetame diavad shappir dame?! ureminhu: "vesamach... veshachat" – ma semicha bithorim, af shechita bithorim! midderabbanan.
May shena semicha, dichtiv: "lifne Adonai"; shechita name, hachtiv: "lifne Adonai"! efshar deaved sakkin arukka veshachet.
Semicha name – efshar dimayyel yedeh vesamech. kasavar bia bemiktzat shemah bia.
Rav chisda matni ippecha: "vesamach... veshachat" – ma shechita bithorin, af semicha bithorin. may shena shechita? dichtiv: "lifne Adonai",
b: Semicha name ketiv: "lifne Adonai"! efshar dimayyel yedeh vesamech. shechita name efshar deaved sakkin arukka veshachet!

Ha manni – shimon hattimni hi. detanya: "veshachat et ben habbakar lifne Adonai" – velo hashshochet lifne Adonai. shimon hattimni omer: minnayin sheyyihyu yadav shel shochet lifnim min hannishchat? talmud lomar: "veshachat et ben habbakar lifne Adonai" – shochet et ben habbakar yehe lifne Adonai.
Amar ulla amar resh lakish: tame shehichnis yado lifnim – loke. shenneemar: "bechol kodesh lo tigga vegomer" – makkish bia lingia; ma negia bemiktzat shemah negia, af bia bemiktzat shemah bia.
Etiveh rav hoshaya leulla: metzora shechal shemini shello lihyot beerev happesach, veraa keri bo bayyom, vetaval –
Amru chachamim: af al pi sheen tevul yom acher nichnas, ze nichnas; mutav yavo ase sheyyesh bo karet, veyidche ase sheen bo karet.

Verabbi yochanan amar: devar tora – afillu ase en bo. shenneemar: "vayyaamod yehoshafat bikhal yehuda virushalim bevet Adonai lifne hechatzer hachadasha" – may "chatzer hachadasha"? amar rabbi yochanan: shechiddeshu bah devarim (harebe), veamru: tevul yom al yikkanes lemachane leviyya.
Vei amrat bia bemiktzat shemah bia, hechi meayyel yedeh bivhonot? idde veidde ase sheyyesh bo karet hu!
Amar leh: mittunach – shane metzora, hoil vehuttar letzarato huttar lekiryo.
Amar rav yosef, kasavar ulla: rubban zavim venaasu temee metim; hoil vehutteru letumeatan – hutteru lezivatan.
Amar leh abbaye: mi dame?! tumea ishteray, ziva la ishteray!
Amar leh, dilma hachi kaamar mar: rubban temee metim venaasu zavim; hoil vehutteru letumeatan – hutteru lezivatan? amar leh: in.
Veakkatti la dame; metzora – hettera hu, hoil veishteri ishteri. tumea – dechuya hi, leha iddechay leha la iddechay!
Amar leh rava: adderabba, ippecha mistabbera! metzora – hettera hu, leha ishteray uleha la ishteray; tumea – dechuya hu, ma li chad dichuya ma li shete dechiyyot?

a: Mikkelal detarvayyhu sevira lehu: tumea dechuya hi betzibbur.
Lema mesayyay leh: kol hassemichot shehayu sham kore alehen ani techef lismicha shechita;
Chutz mizzo shehayta beshaar nikkanor, sheen metzora yachol likkanes lesham ad shemmazzin alav middam chattato umiddam ashamo. vei amrat bia bemiktzat lo shemah bia – liayyel yedeh velismoch!
Amar rav yosef: ha manni – rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi, deamar: merachak tzafon.
Veleeved pishpesh! abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: "hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil et kol melechet hattavnit".
Ikka deamri, amar rav yosef: kol hassomech – rosho verubbo machnis, may tama? kol kocho baenan; hilkach la efshar.
May kasavar? i kasavar semichat asham metzora deorayyta, vetechef lismicha shechita deorayyta – leul velismoch lehedya, derachamana amar!
Amar rav adda bar matna: gezera shemma yarbe bifsiot. ikka deamri, amar rav adda bar matna: semichat asham metzora deorayyta, vetechef lismicha shechita lav deorayyta.
Metivi: "vesamach... veshachat" – ma semicha bithorin, af shechita bithorin. vei amrat lav deorayyta – bitmein name mashkachat la!
Ella efoch – semichat asham metzora lav deorayyta, vetechef lismicha shechita deorayyta.
b: Ravina amar: leinyan malkot ittemar.
Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi avahu: leinyan tame shennaga bakkodesh ittemar.
Deittemar: tame shennaga bekodesh – resh lakish amar: loke, rabbi yochanan amar: eno loke. resh lakish amar loke – "bechol kodesh lo tigga". verabbi yochanan amar eno loke – hahu bitruma ketiv.
Veresh lakish – hay kera lehachi hu daata?! hay mibbee leh: azhara leochel besar kodesh! deittemar: azhara laochel besar kodesh minnayin? resh lakish amar: "bechol kodesh lo tigga".
Rabbi yochanan amar: tane bardela, atya "tumeato"–"tumeato" mibbiat mikdash; ma lehallan anash vehizhir, af kan anash vehizhir.
Tame shennaga bakkodesh – middeappeka rachamana bilshon negia; azhara laochel – middeittakkash kodesh lemikdash.
Tanya kevavteh deresh lakish: "bechol kodesh lo tigga" – azhara laochel. atta omer azhara leochel; o eno ella lannogea?
Talmud lomar: "bechol kodesh lo tigga veel hammikdash lo tavo" – makkish kodesh lemikdash; ma mikdash – davar sheyyesh bo

a: Netilat neshama, af kodesh – davar sheyyesh bo netilat neshama. vei benogea – netilat neshama mi ikka?! ella baachila.
Veakkatti mibbee leh letame sheachal besar kodesh lifne zerika! deittemar: tame sheachal besar kodesh lifne zerika – resh lakish amar: loke, verabbi yochanan amar: eno loke.

Resh lakish amar loke – "bechol kodesh lo tigga", la shena lifne zerika vela shena leachar zerika. rabbi yochanan amar eno loke – kidtane bardela: atya "tumeato"–"tumeato", vechi ketav hahu – leachar zerika.
Im ken, lema kera "bekodesh"; may "bechol kodesh"? shema minna tarte.
Gufa – tame sheachal besar kodesh lifne zerika, resh lakish amar: loke, rabbi yochanan amar: eno loke. amar abbaye: machloket betumeat hagguf, aval betumeat basar – divre hakkol loke.
Deamar kera: "vehabbasar" – lerabbot etzim ulevona delav bene achila ninhu, vaafillu hachi rabbinhu kera.

Verava amar: machloket betumeat hagguf, aval betumeat basar – divre hakkol eno loke. may tama? kevan dela karena beh "vetumeato alav venichreta", la karena beh "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel".
Vehaamar mar: "vehabbasar" – lerabbot etzim ulevona!
Hacha bemay askinan – kegon shekkadshu bichli, denaasa kemi shekkarvu kol mattirav.
Ditnan: kol sheyyesh lo mattirim – mishshekkarvu mattirav. kol sheen lo mattirin – mishshekkadash bichli.

Ittemar: hammaale evre behema temea al gabbe hammizbeach – resh lakish amar: loke, rabbi yochanan amar: eno loke. resh lakish amar loke – tehora in, temea la, velav habba mikkelal ase lokin alav. verabbi yochanan amar en lokin alav – lav habba mikkelal ase en lokin alav.
Motev rabbi yirmeya: "otah tochelu" – velo behema temea; velav habba mikkelal ase, ase.

Amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa, asbera lach: beevre behema temea – dechulle alma la peligi. ki feligi – bechayya; vehachi ittemar: rabbi yochanan amar: over baase, resh lakish amar: eno over bivlo kelum.
Rabbi yochanan amar over baase – behema in, chayya la. resh lakish amar eno over alav bivlo kelum – hahu lemitzva.

Motev rava: illu neemar "korban laAdonai behema" – hayiti omer: chayya bichlal behema, keinyan shenneemar: "zot habbehema asher tochelu shor se chesavim vese izzim ayyal utzevi vegomer". talmud lomar: "bakar vatzon" – bakar vatzon amarti lecha, velo chayya.
Yachol lo yavi, veim hevi kasher? ha lema ze dome – letalmid sheamar lo rabbo "have li chittim", vehevi lo chittim useorim, sheeno kemaavir al devarav ella mosif al devarav, vechasher.

Talmud lomar: "bakar vatzon" – bakar vatzon amarti lecha, velo chayya. ha lema ze dome? letalmid sheamar lo rabbo "al tavi li ella chittin", vehevi lo chittin useorim, sheeno kemosif al devarav ella kemaavir al devarav,
b: Ufasul. teyuveta deresh lakish! teyuveta.
Vechullan shekkibbelu kulei. bea minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan: pasul – mahu sheyyaase shirayim?
Amar leh: en ose shirayim ella chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, hoil umeratztze lefiggulo.

Rav zevid matne hachi – bea minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan: kos pasul, mahu sheyyaase shirayim? amar leh: pasul gufeh may sevira lach? i pasul meshavve shirayim – kos pasul name meshavve shirayim. i pasul la meshavve shirayim – kos pasul name la meshavve shirayim.
Rav yirmeya middifti matne hachi – bea minneh abbaye (merava) [merabba]: kos, mahu sheyyaase et chavero dachuy o shirayim?
Amar leh: pelugeta derabbi elazar berabbi shimon verabbanan. detanya, lemala hu omer: "et damo yishpoch", lematta hu omer: "veet kol damah yishpoch".
Minnayin lechattat shekkibbel damah bearbaa kosot, venatan mattana achat mizze umattana achat mizze – shekkullan nishpachin laysod? talmud lomar: "veet kol damah yishpoch".
Yachol natan arba mattanot mikkos echad, yehu kullan nishpachin laysod? talmud lomar: "veet damo". ha ketzad? hu nishpach laysod, vehen nishpachin laamma.

Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: minnayin lechattat shekkibbel dama bearbaa kosot venatan arba mattanot mikkos echad, shekkullan nishpachin laysod? talmud lomar: "veet kol damah yishpoch". vehachtiv: "veet damo yishpoch"! amar rav ashe: hahu lemaote shirayim shebbetzavvar behema.
Kibbel hakkasher venatan lappasul kulei.
Utzericha; dei ashmeinan pasul, hava amena: may "pasul" – tame, dachaze laavodat tzibbur; aval semol – la.
Vei ashmeinan semol – deit leh hechshera beyom hakkippurim; aval kele chol – la.
Vei ashmeinan kele chol – mishshum dachazu lekaddoshinhu; aval hanach – ema la. tzericha.
Veleheve leh dachuy! amar leh ravina lerav ashe, hachi amar rav yirmeya middifti mishshemeh derava: ha manni – chanan hammitzri hu, delet leh dechuyin.
Detanya, chanan hammitzri omer: afillu dam bakkos, mevi chavero umezavvevg lo.
Rav ashe amar: kol shebbeyado – la have dachuy.

Amar rav shayyay: kevavteh derav ashe mistabbera. man shamat leh deit leh dechuyin – rabbi yehuda; ditnan, veod amar rabbi yehuda: nishpach haddam – yamut hammishtalleach, met hammishtalleach – yishshafech haddam;

Veshaminan leh deamar: kol shebbeyado – la have dachuy. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: kos echad haya memalle middam hattaarovet, vezorko zerika achat keneged hayesod. shema minna: kol shebbeyado – la have dachuy! shema minna.

Gufa – tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: kos echad haya memalle middam hattaarovet, sheim yishshafech echad mehem – nimtza shehu machshiro. amru lo lerabbi yehuda: vahalo lo nitkabbel bichli! mena yadi? ella shemma lo nitkabbel bichli! amar lahen:

a: Af ani lo amarti ella keshennitkabbel bichli. vehu gufeh mena yada? kohanim zerizin, veavdin hayyay umishtafchin.
Vahalo dam hattamtzit meorav bo! rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: dam hattamtzit karuy dam.
Detanya: dam hattamtzit – beazhara. rabbi yehuda omer: becharet.
Vehaamar rabbi elazar: mode rabbi yehuda leinyan kappara sheeno mechapper, shenneemar: "ki haddam hu hannafesh" –
Dam shehannefesh yotza bo karuy dam, sheen hannefesh yotza bo en karuy dam!
Ella rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: en dam mevattel dam.
Amar lahem rabbi yehuda: ledivrechem, lamma pokkin haazara? amru lo: shevach hu livne aharon sheyyehallechu ad archubbotehen baddam.
Veha dam have chatzitza! lach hu, vela have chatzitza. ditnan: haddam vehaddeyo vehaddevash vehechalav – yeveshin chotztzin, lachin en chotztzin.

Veha ka mittavvevsi manayyhu, utenan: hayu begadav metushetashin veavad – avodato pesula! vechi tema dimdallu lehu, vehatanya: "middo" – kemiddato, shello yechasser veshello yotir! beholachat evarim lakkevesh, delav avoda hi.
Vela?! vehatanya: "vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol" – zo holachat evarim lakkevesh! ella beholachat etzim lammaaracha, delav avoda hi. velaavoda hechi azli? azli aitzteve.
Mishna hashshochet et hazzevach leechol davar sheen darko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheen darko lehaketir – kasher. verabbi eliezer posel.
Leechol davar sheddarko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheddarko lehaketir – pachot mikkezayit; kasher. leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit – kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin.

Hashshochet et hazzevach leechol kezayit min haor, umin harotev, umin hakkefe, umin haalal, umin haatzamot, umin haggidin, umin hakkeranayim, umin hattelafayim – chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo; kasher, veen chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame.
Hashshochet et hammukedashin leechol shelil o shilya bachutz – lo piggel. hammolek et hattorin leechol betzehen bachutz – lo piggel.
Chalev mukedashin uvetze torin – en chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame.
Gemara amar rabbi elazar: piggel bazzevach – nitpaggel hashshelil. bashshelil – lo nitpaggel hazzevach. piggel baalal – nitpaggela murea. bammurea – lo nitpaggel alal.
Piggel baemurin – nitpaggelu parim. bapparim – lo nitpaggelu emurim.
Lema mesayyay leh: veshavim sheim chishshev baachilat parim uvisrefatan – lo asa velo chelum. may, lav ha chishshev baemurim – nitpaggelu parim? la;
b: Ha chishshev baemurin – nitpaggelu emurin atzman.
Ta shema: parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim – moalin bahen mishshehukedshu. nishchatu – hucheshru lippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina.
May, lav linat basar – ushema minna: miggo defasla belina, pasla bah machshava?
La; linat emurim. ha middekatane sefa: kullan moalin bahen al bet haddeshen ad sheyyuttach habbasar – mikkelal deresha linat basar! midde irya?! ha kidita veha kidita; resha emurim, vesefa basar.

Motev (rava) [rabba]: veellu sheen mefaggelin veen mitpaggelin: tzemer shebberashe chevasim, usear shebbizkan teyayshim, vehaor, veharotev, vehakkefe, vehaalal, vehammurea, vehaatzamot, vehaggidin, vehakkeranayim, vehattelafayim, vehashshelil, vehashshilya, vachalev hammukedashin, uvetze torin.
[Kullan] lo mefaggelin velo mitpaggelin; veen chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame; vehammaale mehen bachutz – patur.
May, lav lo mefaggelin hazzevach, velo mitpaggelin mechamat zevach?
La; lo mefaggelin et hazzevach, velo mitpaggelin mechamat atzman. i hachi, ha dekatane sefa: kullan lo mefaggelin velo mitpaggelin – ha tu lema li?
Velitamaych, en chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul – ha tu lema li? ella ayyeyde devae lemitna notar vetame, tena piggul;
Hacha name, ayyeyde devae lemitne: hammaale mehen bachutz, tena name: vechullan lo mefaggelin velo mitpaggelin.
Rava amar, af anan name tenena: hashshochet et hammukedashim leechol shelil o shilya bachutz – lo piggel, vehammolek et hattorim leechol betzehem bachutz – lo piggel;
Vahadar tane: chalev hammukedashin uvetze torim – en chayyayv alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame; ha shelil veshilya – chayyayvim!
Ella lav shema minna: kan mechamat hazzevach, kan mechamat atzman? shema minna.
Tenan hatam: uvaale mumin; rabbi akiva machshir bevaale mumim.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lo hichshir rabbi akiva ella bedukkin shebbaayin, hoil uchesherim beofot. vehu shekkadam hekdeshah et mumah.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: umode rabbi akiva beolat nekeva, dichman dikdam mumah lehekdeshah dame.
Metiv rabbi zera: hammaale mehen bachutz – patur. ha meimman – chayyayv; vehechi mashkachat la? beolat nekeva.
I amrat bishlama kasavar rabbi akiva olat nekeva im alta lo tered, ha manni – rabbi akiva hi. ella i amrat im alta tered, ha manni?
Ema: hammaale mehen bachutz – patur, ha meemure imman – chayyayv.
Veha "mehen" katane – veimman dumeya didhu! ella ema: hammaale meemurehen bachutz – patur, ha meemure imman – chayyayv.

Mishna shechato al menat lehanniach et damo o emurav lemachar, o lehotzian lachutz – rabbi yehuda posel vachachamim machshirin. al menat littenan al gabbe hakkevesh; shello keneged hayesod; velitten et hannittanim lemalan – lematta; veet hannittanim lematta – lemalan; veet hannittanim

a: Bifnim – bachutz; veet hannittanin bachutz – bifnim; sheyyochluhu temeim; sheyyakrivuhu temeim; sheyyochluhu arelim; vesheyyakrivuhu arelim; leshabber atzmot happesach; leechol hemennu na; ulearev damo bedam happesulim – kasher.
Sheen machshava poselet ella bechutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, vehappesach vehachattat shello lishman.

Gemara may tama derabbi yehuda? amar rabbi elazar: tere kerae ketivi benotar; katuv echad omer: "lo totiru mimmennu ad boker", vechatuv echad omer: "lo yanniach mimmennu ad boker"; im eno inyan lehinniach, tenehu leinyan machshevet hinnuach.
Verabbi yehuda – hay kera lehachi hu daata?! hay mibbee leh lechidtanya: "uvesar zevach todat shelamav" – lamadnu letoda shenneechelet leyom valayla.
Chalifin, vevladot, temurot – minnayin? talmud lomar: "uvesar". chattat veasham minnayin? talmud lomar: "zevach".
Uminnayin lerabbot shalme nazir veshalme fesach? talmud lomar: "shelamav". lachme toda, vechallot urekikim shebbenazir – minnayin? talmud lomar: "korbano" – kullan kore ani bahen "lo yanniach".
Im ken, lema kera: "lo totiru", may "lo yanniach"? im eno inyan lehinnuach, tenehu inyan lemachshevet hinnuach.
Hatinach lehaniach, lehotzi may ikka lememar?

Veod, tama derabbi yehuda sevara hu! detanya, amar lahem rabbi yehuda: i attem modim sheim hinnicho lemachar – shehu pasul? af chishshev lehannicho lemachar – pasul. ella tama derabbi yehuda sevara hu?! veniflog name rabbi yehuda bechullehu!
Behe niflog? beshover atzmot happesach veleechol mimmennu na – zivcha gufeh mi mippesil?!
Al menat sheyyochluhu temeim vesheyyakrivuhu temeim – zivcha gufeh mi mippesil?! sheyyochluhu arelim vesheyyakrivuhu arelim – zivcha gufeh mi mippesil?! lishshana acharina: kol keminneh?!

Learev daman bedam happesulin – rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: en dam mevattel dam. litten et hannittanin lemala lematta, lematta lemala – rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: shello limkomo name mekomo karena beh.
Veliflog bannittanin bifnim shennetanan bachutz, vehannittanin bachutz shennetanan bifnim!
Kasavar rabbi yehuda: baenan mekom sheyyehe meshullash – bedam, bevasar uveemurin.
Umi it leh lerabbi yehuda hay sevara?! vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: "davar ra" – ribba kan chattat sheshshechatah baddarom vechattat shennichnas damah lifnim, pesula.
Velet lerabbi yehuda shelishi?! vehatnan, amar rabbi yehuda: hichnis beshogeg – kasher. ha bemezid – pasul; vekayyma lan beshekkipper.
Hasheta uma hatam (ayyli ayyla) [deayyole ayyeyleh], i kipper in i lo kipper la; hacha dechashshev chashshove, lo kol shekken?! tere tannae veallibba derabbi yehuda.
Vesavar rabbi yehuda: chattat sheshshechatah baddarom –
b: Yehe chayyayv?!

Vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: yachol chattat sheshshechatah baddarom – yehe chayyayv? talmud lomar: "lo tizbach laAdonai elohecha shor vase vegomer kol davar ra" – al davar ra atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo al chattat sheshshechatah baddarom! tere tannae allibba derabbi yehuda.
Amar rabbi abba: umode rabbi yehuda, shechozer vekovo lefiggul.
Amar rava: tidda – defiggul lifne zerika la kelum hu, veatya zerika vekava la befiggul.
Vela hi; hatam hu chada machshava hi, hacha tere machshavot.

Etiveh rav huna lerabbi abba: litten et hannittanin lemala lematta, lematta lemala; lealtar – kasher. chazar vechishshev chutz limkomo – pasul, veen bo karet. chutz lizmanno – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet.
Lemachar – pasul. chazar vechishshev ben chutz lizmanno ben chutz limkomo – pasul, veen bo karet. teyuveta derabbi abba! teyuveta.
Amar rav chisda amar ravina bar sela: chishshev sheyyochluhu temeim lemachar – chayyayv. amar rava: tidda, devasar lifne zerika la chaze, vechi mechashshev beh – mippesil.
Vela hi; hatam zarek umichaze, hacha la michze kelal.
Amar rav chisda, margela befummeh derav dimi bar chinnana: besar pesach shello hutzela, velachme toda shello huremu – chayyayvin alehen mishshum tumea.
Amar rava: tidda, detanya: "asher laAdonai" – lerabbot emure kadashim kallim letumea.
Alma af al gav delav bene achila ninhu – chayyayvin alehen mishshum tumea; hacha name, af al gav delav bene achila ninhu – chayyayvin alehen mishshum tumea.
Vela hi; hatam – emure kadashim kallim chazu legavoah; leappoke besar pesach shello hutzela velachme toda shello huremu – dela chazu la legavoah vela lehedyot.
Lishshana acharina: ha emurin la chazu! vela hi; hanach chazu lemilletayyhu, vehane la chazu kelal.
Hadaran alach kol happesulin
Mishna bet shammay omrim: kol hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon, shennatan bemattana achat – kipper. uvechattat – shete mattanot. uvet hillel omrim: af chattat shennetanah mattana achat – kipper.
Lefichach im natan et harishona ketiknah veet hashsheniyya chutz lizmannah – kipper.
Veim natan et harishona chutz lizmannah veet hashsheniyya chutz limkomah – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet.
Kol hannittanin al hammizbeach happenimi – sheim chisser achat min hammattanot, keillu lo kipper. lefichach, natan kullan ketiknan veachat shello ketiknah – pesula, veen bo karet.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: minnayin lannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon, shennetanan bemattana achat – shekkipper? talmud lomar: "vedam zevachecha yishshafech". vehay lehachi hu daata?! hay mibbee leh lechidtanya:

a: Minnayin lechol haddamim shetteunim mattan dam laysod? talmud lomar: "vedam zevachecha yishshafech". nafka leh midderabbi – detanya, rabbi omer: "vehannishar baddam yimmatze" – sheen talmud lomar "baddam"; uma talmud lomar "baddam"?

Lefi shello lamadnu ella lannittanin mattan arba – shetteunin mattan damim laysod; shear damim minnayin? talmud lomar: "vehannishar baddam yimmatze" – sheen talmud lomar "baddam"; uma talmud lomar "baddam"? limmed al kol haddamim, shetteunin mattan damim laysod.
Veakkatti lehachi hu deata?! mibbee leh lechidtanya: minnayin lannittanin bizrika shennetanan bishficha – yatza? talmud lomar: "vedam zevachecha yishshafech".
Savar la kerabbi akiva, deamar: lo zerika bichlal sheficha, velo sheficha bichlal zerika.
Ditnan: berach birkat happesach – patar et shel zevach.
Shel zevach – lo patar et happesach. divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: lo zo poteret zo, velo zo poteret zo.

Akkatti lehachi hu daata?! mibbee leh lechidtanya, rabbi yishmael omer: mittoch shenneemar "ach bechor shor o vechor kesev o vechor ez vegomer" – lamadnu livchor, shettaun mattan damim veemurim legabbe mizbeach. maaser ufesach minnayin? talmud lomar: "vedam zevachecha yishshafech".
Savar la kerabbi yose haggelili.
Detanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: "damo" lo neemar, ella "damam"; "chelbo" lo neemar, ella "chelbam"; limmed al bechor, maaser ufesach, shettaun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach.
Verabbi yishmael – hay kera, mappek leh lehachi umappek leh lehachi?! tere tannae allibba derabbi yishmael.
Bishlama lerabbi yishmael, demokem le kulleh bivchor – hayeynu dichtiv: "uvesaram yihye lach".
Ella lerabbi yose, demoke leh name bemaaser vafesach – maaser vafesach bealim achli leh; may "uvesaram yihye lach"? echad tam veechad baal mum;
b: Limmed al bechor baal mum, shennittan lakkohen. shello matzinu lo bechol hattora kullah.
Verabbi yishmael – nafka leh millecha yihye" desefa.
Bishlama lerabbi yose haggelili, demoke leh name bemaaser vafesach; hayeynu dichtiv: "lo tifde ki kodesh hem" – hem kerevin, veen temuratan kereva.
Ditnan: temurat bechor umaaser – hen uveladan uvelad veladan ad sof kol haolam, hare hen kivchor umaaser, veyochlu bemuman labbealim.
Utenan, amar rabbi yehoshua: shamati shettemurat pesach kereva, utemurat pesach enah kereva, veen li lefaresh.
Ella lerabbi yishmael, demoke leh kulleh bivchor; maaser vafesach dela kereva temuratan, mena leh? maaser gamar "avara"–"avara" mibbechor.
Pesach – behedya ketiv beh kesev; ma talmud lomar "im kesev" – lerabbot temurat happesach achar happesach, shettikrav shelamim. yachol af lifne happesach ken? talmud lomar "hu".

Vechol hanach tannae demappeki leh lehay "dam zevachecha yishshafech" lidrasha acharina – hay kol hannittanin al mizbeach hachitzon shennetanan mattana achat shekkipper, mena lehu? savri lehu kevet hillel, deamri: af chattat shennetanah mattana achat – kipper; veyalfinan kullehu mechattat.
Vehachattat shete mattanot. amar rav huna: may tama devet shammay?
"Karnot", "karnot", "karnot" – hare kan shesh; arbaa lemitzva ushetayim leakkev.
Uvet hillel: "karnat", "karnat", "karnot" – hare kan arba; shalosh lemitzva, achat leakkev.
Veema kullehu lemitzva! kappara bichdi la ashkechan.
Veibbaet ema, hayeynu tama devet hillel: ahani mikra, veahni masoret; ahani mikra – letappoye chada, veahanay masoret – levatztzore chada.
Ella meatta, "letotefet", "letotefet", "letotafot" – hare kan arba; ahani kera veahanay masoret – chamsha batte bae lemibad!
Savar la kerabbi akiva, deamar: "tat" bechatpi shetayim, "pat" beafriki shetayim.
Ella meatta, "besukkat", "besukkat", "bassukkot" – ahani mikra veahanay masoret, chamesh dafnata bae lemibad!

a: Hatam chad kera – kulleh legufeh, vechad – lischacha; atay hilcheta, ugerata lishlishit veokemta attefach.
Ella meatta, "vetama shevuayim" – "shivim"; ahani kera veahanay masoret – arbeim uteren baaya lemetav!
Shane hatam, dichtiv "keniddatah".
Vetanna mayyte la mehacha: "vechipper" "vechipper" "vechipper" – mippene haddin.

Sheyyachol vahalo din hu: neemru damim lematta, veneemru damim lemala; ma mattan damim haamurim lematta – shennetanan bemattana achat, kipper; af damim haamurim lemala – shennetanan bemattana achat, kipper.

O kelach lederech zo: neemru damim bifnim, veneemru damim bachutz; ma damim haamurim bifnim – chisser achat min hammattanot, lo asa velo kelum; af damim haamurin bachutz – chisser achat min hammattanot, lo asa velo chelum.
Nire lemi dome. danin chutz michutz, veen danin chutz mibbifnim; o kallech lederech zo – danin chattat vearba keranot, mechattat vearba keranot; veal yochiach chutz – sheen chattat vearba keranot?

Talmud lomar: "vechipper" "vechipper" "vechipper" (mippene haddin); "vechipper" – af al pi shello natan ella shalosh, "vechipper" – af al pi shello natan ella shetayim, "vechipper" – af al pi shello natan ella achat.
Vehay mibbee leh legufeh! amar rava: bar adda mari asbera li – amar kera: "vechipper... venislach" – zo hi kappara zo hi selicha.

Ema "vechipper" – af al pi shello natan ella shalosh lemala veachat lematta, "vechipper" – af al pi shello natan ella shetayim lematta ushetayim lemala, "vechipper" – af al pi shello natan lemala ella lematta!
Amar rav adda bar yitzchak: im ken, bittalta torat arba keranot. vei rachamana amar, libbatlun!
Amar rava: ezehu davar shetztzarich shalosh? heve omer: ellu keranot.
Ema: "vechipper" – af al pi shello natan ella achat lemala veshalosh lematta!
Lo matzinu damim shechetzyayn lemala vechetzyayn lematta. vela?! vehatnan: hizza mimmennu achat lemala vesheva lematta!
Kematzlif. may kematzlif? machve rav yehuda: kimnaggedana.
Hizza al tohoro shel mizbeach sheva peamim.
b: May, lav appalgeh demizbeach – kidamri inashe: "tehar tihara deyoma"? amar rava bar shela: la, aggilluyeh; dichtiv: "ucheetzem hashshamayim latohar".
Vehaikka shirayim! shirayim la meakkevi.
Vehaikka shirayim happenimim, deikka deman deamar meakkevi! bechad makom kaamrinan.
Tanya: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, bet shammay omrim: shete mattanot shebbachattat, veachat shebbechol hazzevachim – mattirot umefaggelot.
Bet hillel omrim: achat shebbachattat veachat shebbechol hazzevachim – matteret umefaggelet.
Matkef la rav oshaya: im ken, litneyay gabbe kulle bet shammay vechumere bet hillel!
Amar leh rava: ki itteshil – lehettera itteshil; dehavu lehu bet shammay lechumera.
Amar rabbi yochanan: shalosh mattanot shebbachattaot – enan baot ballayla, uvaot leachar mita, vehammaale mehen bachutz chayyayv.
Amar rav pappa: yesh mehen kitchillato veyesh mehen kesofo;
Chutz, velayla, zarut, uchele sharet, keren, veetzba, kibbus, veshirayim – kitchillatan;
Uvaot leachar mita, la sharya, vela mefaggela, vela ayyla legavvay – kesofan.
Amar rav pappa: mena amena la? ditnan: nittaz min hatztzavvar al habbeged – eno taun kibbus. min hakkeren umin hayesod – eno taun kibbus. ha min harauy lekeren – taun kibbus.
Velitamaych, min hayesod eno taun kibbus – ha min harauy laysod taun kibbus?! "asher yizze" ketiv – perat laze shekkevar huzza!
Ha manni – rabbi nechemya; ditnan, rabbi nechemya omer: sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz – chayyayv.
Emar deshamat leh lerabbi nechemya – leinyan haalaa, midde dehave aevarim ufedarim; leinyan kibbus – mi shamat leh?! in;

a: Vehatanya: damim hatteunin yesod – teunin kibbus, umachshava moelet bahen, vehammaale mehen bachutz chayyayv;
Vedamim hannishpachin laamma – en teunin kibbus, veen machshava moelet bahen, vehammaale mehen bachutz patur.
Man shamat leh deamar maale mehen bachutz chayyayv – rabbi nechemya hi; vekaamar: taun kibbus.
Umachshava moelet bahen?! vehatanya: yatzu shirayim vehaketarat emurin, sheen meakkevin et hakkappara – sheen machshava moelet bahen!
Ki tanya hahi – beshalosh mattanot shebbachattat.
I hachi, teunin yesod?! lekeren azli! ema: nitanin yesod. umachshava moelet bahen?! haamrat: la sharya vela mefaggela vela ayyla legavvay – kesofan!
Ella ki tanya hahi – bedamim happenimiyyim.
Aval bedamim hachitzonim may, patur?! addetane damim hannishpachin laamma; liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim – bedamim happenimiyyim, aval bedamim hachitzonim – patur!
Ha manni – rabbi nechemya hi, deamar: sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz – chayyayv; vela matne leh telata peture levahade telata chiyyuve.
Ravina amar: min hakkeren – mammash, min hayesod – min harauy laysod.

Amar leh rav tachlifa bar gazza leravina: ema idde veidde rauy hu! hay may? hasheta rauy lakkeren – amrat la; rauy laysod mibbaya?! ella min hakkeren – min hakkeren mammash, min hayesod – min harauy laysod.
Kol hannittanin al mizbeach happenimi kulei. tanu rabbanan: "veasa kaasher asa" – ma ba lilmod?
Lichpol behazzaato; velamad sheim chissar achat mikkol hammattanot – lo asa velo kelum. en li ella mattan sheva, shemmeakkevot bechol makom; mattan arba minnayin? talmud lomar: "ken yaase".
"Lappar" – ze par yom hakkippurim,
b: "Kaasher asa lefar" – ze par kohen mashiach. "hachattat" – ellu seire avoda zara. yachol sheani merabbe af seire hargalim useire rashe chodashim? talmud lomar: "lo".
Uma raita lerabbot et ellu ulehotzi et ellu? achar sheribba hakkatuv umiet, merabbe ani et ellu shemmechapperin al averat mitzva yedua, umotzi ani ellu sheen mechapperin al averat mitzva yedua.
"Vechipper" – af al pi shello samach. "venislach" – af al pi shello natan shirayim.
Uma raita lifsol behazzaot, ulehachshir bismicha veshirayim?
Amarta: posel [ani] behazzaot – shemmeakkevot bechol makom, umachshir ani bismicha veshirayim – sheen meakkevot bechol makom.

a: Amar mar: en li ella mattan sheva shemmeakkevot bechol makom. hecha? amar rav pappa: befara uvingaim.
Mattan arba minnayin? talmud lomar: "ken yaase". may shena mattan sheva – dichtivan uchefilan, mattan arba name – ketivan uchefilan!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: lo nitzrecha ella lerabbi shimon. detanya, lemala omer: "keren"–"karnot" – shetayim; lematta hu omer: "keren"–"karnot" – arba. divre rabbi shimon.
Rabbi yehuda omer: eno tzarich; hare hu omer: "beohel moed" – al kol haamur beohel moed. verabbi yehuda, "ken yease" may aved leh?
Mibbee leh lechidtanya: lefi shello lamadnu lefar yom hakkippurim lismicha. usheyare haddam minnayin? talmud lomar: "ken yaase".
Ulefar yom hakkippurim lo lamadnu? ha amarta: "lappar" – ze yom hakkippurim!
Itzterich; salka datach amena: hane mille – avoda dimakkeva kappara, aval avoda dela meakkeva kappara – ema la; kamashma lan.
Verabbi shimon, hay "beohel moed" may aved leh? "beohel moed" mibbee leh sheim nifchata tikra shel hechol, lo haya mazze. veiddach – measher". veiddach – "asher" la daresh.
Abbaye amar: lerabbi yehuda name itzterich; salka datach amena: midde dehave assemicha usheyare haddam – deaf al gav dichtivan uchefilan la meakkeva, mattan arba name la titakkav; ka mashma lan.
"Lappar" – ze par yom hakkippurim. lemay hilcheta? i leakkev – peshita, "chukka" ketiva beh!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lo nitzrecha ella lerabbi yehuda, deamar: ki ketiva "chukka" – addevarim hannaasim bevigde lavan bifnim, sheim hikdim maase lachavero – lo asa velo chelum;
Aval devarim hannaasim bevigde lavan bachutz, hikdim maase lachavero – ma sheasa asuy; ema middichsidran la meakkevi, hazzaot name la meakkevi; ka mashma lan.

Veitzterich lemichtav "baddam", dei ketav rachamana "vetaval" – hava amena: af al gav delekka shiur tevila meikkara; ketav rachamana "baddam".
Vei ketav rachamana "baddam" – hava amena: afillu mesappeg; ketav rachamana: "vetaval".
"Mizbach ketoret sammim" lema li? sheim lo nitchannech hammizbeach biktoret hassammim – lo haya mazze.
Tanya kevavteh derav pappa: "veasa... kaasher asa" – ma talmud lomar "lappar"? lerabbot par yom hakkippurim lechol ma sheamur bainyan. divre rabbi.
Amar rabbi yishmael: kal vachomer! uma bemakom shello husheva korban lekorban – hishva maasim lemaasim; makom shehishva korban lekorban – eno din sheyyashve maase lemaase?!
Ella ma talmud lomar "lappar" – ze par helem davar shel tzibbur. "lefar" – ze par kohen mashiach.
Amar mar: uma bimkom shello husheva korban lekorban. may lo husheva korban lekorban?
Illema par yom hakkippurim useir yom hakkippurim – ikka lemifrach: ma lehanach, shekken nichnas damam lifnayy velifnim!
